_comment: STATUS VOCABULARY, pinned from the builder source: voice_e911_addresses has NO status column (prisma model voice_e911_addresses; builder route src/app/api/olympus/voice/e911/route.ts). The vocabulary is the nullable verified_at timestamp - non-null means verified/registered with the carrier (the Olympus POST twin writes the row only AFTER Telnyx accepts, stamped verified_at), null means pending verification (rows the dashboard lane wrote before carrier verification completed; the list tool's registered description says 'registered + pending verification'). voice_diagnose_setup counts verified_at NOT NULL rows as verified_e911_addresses. Served to the session as { data: [rows] } via the resource=e911 dispatcher - this _comment key is never served.
